35503: Honoka Takamiya (多華宮　仄 Takamiya Honoka?) is the male protagonist of the story. He is a second year student and the new student council president of Tougetsu Academy.
35504: The female protagonist of the series. She is known as "Princess" by many female students due to her intelligence and high grades, which makes her the most popular girl at Tougetsu Academy.
35505: Tanpopo Kuraishi is one of the "Tower Witches" who transferred to Honoka Takamiya and Ayaka Kagari's high school, Tougetsu Academy.
43511: Kasumi Takamiya is daughter of Komachi Takamiya and younger sister of Honoka Takamiya. She is a Workshop Witch. She is studying in Tougetsu Academy's girls middle school branch.
129725: Kotetsu Katsura is a tower witch and an underling of Medusa. She is transferred with other tower witches after the second loss of Tanpopo Kuraishi, to Honoka Takamiya's class.
129726: Kanae Hozuki is one of the caretakers of Ayaka Kagari in middle school along with Touko. They helped her to interact with society. She is almost like a manager to Ayaka in middle school. She is member of Ayaka's fanclub as well as a student council member.
129727: Kasumi and Honoka's mother. She can be very optimistic and at the same time very pessimistic. She can't handle pressure and harsh words from others. She was once scolded by Kasumi and went into her cycle of depression. Komachi is also friends with Kazane.
129728: Natsume Mikage (深影　棗?) is the leader of five Workshop Witches from Tougetsu Junior High School that cooperate with Kazane Kagari to protect Tougetsu City. She also happens to be the niece of chemistry teacher Kyoichiro Mikage.
129729: A soft-spoken witch with cat-like ears who wields a large sword. Atori prefers to talk through a small, magical ventriloquist doll she keeps nearby at almost all times. Has a questionable understanding of first-aid.
129730: Ai is one of the "Tower Witches" who transferred to high school, Tougetsu Academy.
129731: Evermillion (エヴァーミリオン?), fully named White Princess Evermillion (白姫エヴァーミリオン Shirohime Evamirion?), is an entity of unknown origin sealed inside Honoka Takamiya. She is addressed as the White Princess by various characters. A total of five seals were placed on her.
129732: Medusa (メデューサ?) is the leader of KMM Gang, and a very powerful Tower Witch that is after Honoka Takamiya for the White Princess Evermilion who was sealed inside of him for an unknown reason.
129733: Mii is one of the "Tower Witches" who transferred to high school, Tougetsu Academy.
129734: Rin Kazari is a Tower Witch. She is transferred with other tower witches after the second loss of Tanpopo Kuraishi to Honoka Takamiya's class.
129735: She is Tanpopo's colleague. She and four of her fellow "Witches of the Tower" form the 'Ivory Quintet," group of witches assigned to transfer to Takamiya's school with the task of capturing him—that is if they can deal with Ayaka first.
129736: Kyochiro Mikage is a Workshop Witch who has the power to erase memories and manipulate dimensions and consciousness of people. He is chemistry teacher at Tougetsu Academy and adviser of the student council.
129737: Kazane Kagari is the commander of Workshop Witches in Tougetsu City and the chairwoman of the school where Honoka Takamiya is studying. She is the mother of Ayaka Kagari and the best friend of Honoka Takamiya's mother.
129738: Chronoire Schwarz VI is a powerful tower witch. She first appeared in front of Kazane Kagari to inform her that she will unseal the "white princess". She is shown to be very knowledgeable about the things going around Honoka Takamiya.
129739: Kanna Utsugi is a Tower Witch and the member of the Ivory Quintet―KMM Gang. She is transferred with other members of KMM Gang after the second loss of Tanpopo Kuraishi to Honoka Takamiya's class. She is a underling of Medusa.
156338: A workshop witch and the school's student council vice-president who works in a maid cafe that is only known to other workshop witches. Like any other student in her school, she too greatly admires Kagari. She specializes in freezing or ice spells.
203949: A Workshop Witch and Kasumi's teacher in the Workshop hierarchy, who also runs a gang of delinquents that dress up in hamster-themed costumes. Nicknamed "Bear Killer" after allegedly choking a tiger (named "Bear-eye") to death with her bare hands.
